purpose: Let the artist explicitly mark one exact canonical Song Version as approved from the normal /song Version history now that Versions are visible and owned local audio can be heard, using stale-safe server authority that binds the rendered active Song, current Version and prior approved Version while preserving current/history/material state.

lineage.outcome: The artist can hear and inspect Song Versions, then deliberately approve one exact Version without making it current, deleting alternatives, or confusing approval with release/publication authority.
lineage.capability: Exact stale-safe canonical Song Version approval through normal Version history

why_now: PR #55 landed verified local Version audition, completing the first honest see→hear prerequisite for a bounded decision. Canonical LineageStore already has approve_version and ActivityLog already emits VERSION_APPROVED when approved_version_id changes. REQ-SCOPE-013 requires latest-versus-approved truth and REQ-SCOPE-041 requires exact-revision approval with stale invalidation. This is therefore a construction-ready consumer seam rather than a new decision model.
instead_of: A new decision ledger is not selected because canonical Version approval and Activity chronology already exist; LearningMemory is a separate Session change→consequence→decision substrate and should not be repurposed as approval state.
Full loudness-aware A/B is not selected because no clean-room loudness analysis/normalization substrate exists yet.
First-class reference objects are not selected because approval of owned Version alternatives is now a smaller direct completion of the active Try→Hear→Compare→Decide loop.
Musical derivation is not selected because the clean-room destination still lacks a truthful audio-analysis engine.
Another DAW chassis increment is not selected because exact Version approval is host-independent and directly advances owned Song decision continuity.
completion_proof: each non-approved Version in the exact active Song history has a precise artist-facing approval action that names the Version being approved and does not imply publication or release
server-owned one-shot approval authority binds active Song, target Version, rendered current Version and rendered approved Version including no-approved state
foreign Origin, bad CSRF, replay, active-Song change, current-Version change, prior-approved change and cross-Song target fail closed before approved_version_id changes
approving any exact Version changes only approved_version_id; current_version_id, immutable Version/Asset lineage and managed material bytes remain unchanged
approval may intentionally differ from current and the Song surface shows that truth independently
the canonical Activity chronology gains one VERSION_APPROVED event bound to the approved Version without a parallel approval log
navigation and Quit/relaunch preserve the approved Version and regenerate action authority
Sessions, Learning/Evidence, Focus, Operations, DAWs, providers and external state remain unchanged
authored HTTP/security/invariant/restart tests remain separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
next_selection_rule: After this increment lands or blocks, globally reselect. Compare fuller Try→Hear→Compare→Decide, reference objects, Creative Studio, Learning decision reachability, audio-analysis substrate, DAW/OPS and other portfolio outcomes. Do not continue by label adjacency.
